Name: Invite Friend
ActivityDes: You can share your invite code to Lv.≥20 commandants. If they use your code, you will have invited them successfully.

Name: Invite Code
ActivityDes: Welcome back to Gray Raven HQ. You can input the invite code of other commandants to receive corresponding rewards.

Name: Returning Player Experience Survey
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
In order to create a better gaming environment, the Command Central has decided to conduct a survey regarding the in-game experiences of returning players. Please tap the [Advance] button below to share your thoughts! Rewards will be granted upon completion of the survey.

Name: Return Support
ActivityDes: During the event, commandants in the "Return" state can complete the missions and get the rewards (the event ends when the Return state expires).

Name: The Dying Sun
ActivityDes: Event Info: Play through the new story [The Dying Sun] and complete missions.

Name: Simulated Battlefield
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.16.
Mission Info:
1. Earn Simulation Scores upon clearing a stage.
2. Spend Simulation Scores to purchase items at the Simulation Shop.
3. The limited-time shop exchange ends on June 1, 2026, at 23:00 (UTC).
4. During the event period, clear Simulated Battlefield stages and consume a certain amount of serum to claim rewards.

Name: Butter Coffee Wonders
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. Defend the Butter Coffee Shop and clear out malfunctioning robots.
2. The event includes 8 stages. After clearing Hard stages, you can take on Endless Challenge.
3. During the event, you will control characters to dodge enemy attacks, collect powerful items and skills, fight back waves of enemies, and protect the coffee shop.
4. First clears and wave completions grant Cafe Stamps, which you can use in out-of-stage training to boost character stats and unlock powerful items that help you defeat stronger enemies.
5. Beat the designated challenges to complete missions and claim Event Construct R&D Tickets, Trade Vouchers, and other items.

Name: Earthy Camping
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. Plan the team-building route and guide Kamui as he escorts each member to their assigned location.
2. The event features 4 chapters, each with multiple stages that unlock over time and as you progress through earlier stages.
3. During the event, you will need to plan Kamui's route and clear stages while delivering each member to the corresponding location.
4. Make smart use of stage mechanics and arrange the members' arrival order carefully.
5. Clear designated stages and earn chapter stars to complete missions and claim rewards.

Name: Rapid Pursuit
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.42

Event Info:
1. This event features 4 stages, each with 4 difficulty levels.
2. Defeat Bosses of different difficulties in bounties with the required characters.
3. Complete bounty missions to claim rewards.

Name: Desperado Clash
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. A new limited-time season of [Desperado Clash] mode is now available.
2. This season features faster global point gain, the return of accessory and character leveling systems, plus new accessories to boost your combat power and resource earnings.
3. A limited-time shop is open during the event. Play any mode in [The Godfall Revelation] to earn Pristine Crystals, which can be exchanged for rewards. The event ends on June 1 at 05:00 (UTC).
4. Use [R&D Tickets] from the event shop to increase your rank in Desperado Clash and earn exclusive [Nameplates]!

Name: The Absence Sings
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. There are a total of 6 difficulty levels, all of which are highly challenging with [Ezette] being your formidable enemy.
2. All members will be reset once knocked out during the challenge, making the challenge easier to complete.
3. Each stage has its own 3-star clearance conditions. Collectibles will be rewarded once you have earned a total of 3 stars. The more stars you earn, the higher the quality of the collectibles will be.

ActivityDes:

Name: CUB Target
ActivityDes:
New CUB:
※S-Rank CUB: [Ignis]
※Recommended for the character [Kamui: Aeternion]
※[Ignis] will be added to the [CUB Research] Pool.
When conducting CUB Research, it is allowed to choose any S-Rank CUB for target research.
During the event, if [Ignis] is selected for target research, it will have a 100% drop rate among S-Rank CUB.

Name: Stellar Memories
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40 and clear Main Story 1-8

Event Info:
In this coating rerun event, you can choose and research a coating.
Eligible coatings included: [Love's Dawn], [Tsubaki], [Solitary Longings], and [Solitary Dream].
You may choose 1 of the coatings to research. The selected coating cannot be changed afterward.

Name: Tactical Assessment Manual
ActivityDes:
Requirements: 
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. Accumulate Intel Value by completing the Rating Missions of the Daily, the Round, and the current Intel Manual.
2. Raise the Rating Level by reaching the required Intel Value.
3. You will obtain the corresponding reward upon reaching the required Rating Level.
4. You can also purchase additional Intel to get better rewards.
